text:
omar_finance: FYI — billing flag: AcmeCorp private commit shows a -1200 USD offset in the edge-meter for Jan. Anyone else see this?
leah_sales: whoa, can you paste the invoice lines? the customer is mid-renewal so we need clear numbers.
emily_kg: tagging @omar_finance — also cc @maria_custsuccess. I pulled the metering export yesterday; something odd around 2025-12-29 ingest job.
omar_finance: here's the snippet from billing-export.csv:
```
2025-12-29,acmecorp,edge-meter,usage_units,-300
2026-01-15,acmecorp,edge-meter,usage_units,-900
```
leah_sales: negative units? that's not right. maybe a duplicate reversal event.
nate_ops: ops-bot shows two ingestion retries on 12/29 — possible duplicate reversal. I'll check logs.
ops-bot: deploy 2025-12-29T22:14Z: meter-ingest v3.1 triggered retry(2) for acmecorp
maria_custsuccess: Acme's renewals rep is asking for an amendment. If we adjust, need finance approval and a credit memo. @omar_finance what's the proposed path?
omar_finance: proposal: re-ingest corrected lines, then generate a credit memo for $1,200 and apply to next renewal invoice. Need finance sign-off and sales authorization.
leah_sales: sales approves the credit to be applied against the renewal as long as we document reason. @alex_legal, any contract concerns? 
alex_legal: quick read — allowed to issue credit for billing errors; need an internal audit trail. Please attach logs and a root-cause note.
omar_finance: I'll create a ticket in billing-ops with logs + root-cause + suggested JV. Will need approval from @finance-lead.
finance-lead: approve pending ticket ID and attachment of the corrected CSV. Please include the customer's contact note.
omar_finance: creating ticket now: BILL-4821. attaching csv + logs. I'll follow up when re-ingest completes. :thumbsup: 
leah_sales: add line for support-tier adjustment? they bumped to enterprise mid quarter; should the platform fee proration be recalculated?
emily_kg: yes, proration delta needs recompute. I'll run the proration job after the re-ingest and post results.
ops-bot: job proration.compute(ACME,2026-Q1) queued by emily_kg
maria_custsuccess: keeping customer in the loop: sent note that we're investigating and we may issue a credit against renewal invoice.
omar_finance: timeline: re-ingest + validation 24h, credit memo + apply to renewal within 48-72h. flagging for priority.
leah_sales: thanks team. If anything blocks approvals ping me directly.
